title: Implement reproducible random, prototype, and lexical policies
description:
## Scope

Harden the current random-balanced and lexical-overlap policies; extract a transparent class-prototype policy from the experiment. Make seed behavior, tie breaking, class coverage, and fixed-global versus per-target selection explicit.

## Definition of done

Same inputs and versions produce the same IDs; lexical ranking and ties have meaningful specs; policy metadata makes selection assumptions auditable. More expensive semantic retrieval is a later candidate, not a prerequisite.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: Implement reproducible random, prototype, and lexical policies
  Scenario: Required observable behavior
    Given a fixed candidate pool, target, task, and policy seed
    When the policy is run twice
    Then the same ordered demonstration IDs and policy fingerprint are returned
```

comments.author: home
comments.text: Terra implementation reviewed against the acceptance scenarios. Independent offline suite passed 144 specs. Coverage includes nested balanced random/prototype/retrieval selection, custom-policy membership and target-exclusion guards, complete request fingerprints, independent presentation order and token estimates, development-only optimization, provisional versus frozen winner, cumulative scoped call accounting, and cache-only replay. No live provider calls or dataset downloads.
